page._title: Smokeless — Count. Cut down. Quit. | Quit smoking app
page.hero.title: Count. Cut down. Quit.
page.hero.tagline: What you count, you cut. What you cut, you quit.
page.hero.lead: Every cigarette you notice makes the next one harder. Smokeless sets a target that drops a little every day and stays with you through every craving — until there is nothing left to count.
page.hero.free: Free · No account needed · Home screen widget · 15 languages
page.features.title: Everything you need to quit
page.features.lead: Craving support is the app's main action, not logging. Every craving you resist counts.
page.f1.d: Paced breathing, a five-minute countdown and rotating coping suggestions help you ride out the urge.
page.f2.d: Quit completely or cut down gradually. Your daily target falls automatically every day.
page.f3.d: See what changes as you stay smoke-free, from 20 minutes to 15 years.
page.f4.d: Count the cigarettes you didn't smoke and the money that stays in your pocket.
page.f5.d: Hourly, weekly and yearly charts show when your urges cluster.
page.f6.d: Reach free, confidential national quit services and helplines in one tap.
page.widget.title: You don't even need to open the app to count
page.widget.lead: The Smokeless widget lives on your home screen and reminds you how far you've come every time you look.
page.widget.l1: Smoke-free time on a live timer
page.widget.l3: One-tap recording keeps your plan accurate
page.screens.title: Take a look inside
page.screens.lead: A calm, simple interface that never judges you.
page.privacy.title: Your data stays with you
page.privacy.d: Smokeless has no account and no remote server. Your records and settings stay on your device, and you can export or restore a local backup at any time.
page.cta.title: Take your first smoke-free step today
page.cta.lead: Free on iPhone, iPad and Android.
page.disclaimer: Smokeless is a self-help tool. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment and is not a substitute for professional quit support. For clinical support, talk to a healthcare professional or your national quitline.
page._desc: Count. Cut down. Quit. Smokeless is a free quit-smoking app with craving support, a taper plan, a health recovery timeline and a home screen widget. On iPhone and Android.
page.alt.hero: Smokeless home screen with the craving button
page.alt.01-craving: Home screen: smoke-free timer and craving button
page.alt.02-ride-it-out: Five-minute craving session with paced breathing
page.alt.04-plan: Taper plan with a daily target that goes down
page.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
page.faq.a1: Yes. Smokeless is free on iPhone, iPad and Android. It shows ads, but never on the craving support, recovery or quit-support screens.
page.faq.q2: Does counting cigarettes really help me smoke less?
page.faq.a2: Counting turns an automatic habit into a conscious choice. Smokeless pairs it with a daily target that keeps going down and with support for every craving, so counting becomes a path to zero.
page.faq.q3: Do I need an account? Where is my data stored?
page.faq.a3: No account is needed. Everything stays on your device, and you can export or restore a local backup at any time.
page.faq.q4: Is there a home screen widget?
page.faq.a4: Yes. On iPhone and Android the widget shows your smoke-free time and today's count, and lets you record with one tap.
page.faq.a5: No. Smokeless is a self-help tool. A doctor or pharmacist can offer treatments that roughly double your chance of quitting for good.
